channel.title: Cerqa Blog
channel.description: Guides for sharing your location with family and friends, road trips with a group, meeting up and getting everyone there, on iPhone and Android.

item.title: How to keep multiple cars together on a road trip
item.description: Traveling in two or three cars? Here is how to stay together without texting while you drive: share live locations, see everyone's arrival time, plan your stops and find each other again after a split.

item.title: How to share your location between iPhone and Android
item.description: iPhone to Android, Android to Android, or iPhone to iPhone. Here is how to share live location with anyone, for a few minutes or a whole day, and see when everyone will arrive.
